payload.prompt:
OracleGuardedVault ^0.8.20 on Camp (BaseCAMP). A tokenized vault (ERC4626-like) with oracle-based deposit/withdrawal guards and circuit breaker.
Requirements:
- Accept underlying ERC20; mint shares pro-rata; fees (management+performance) to treasury; emit Deposit/Withdraw/FeeAccrued.
- External price oracle (interface) used to cap daily net inflows/outflows and reject operations on abnormal price deviation > maxDrawdown.
- Admin can set oracle, fee bps, daily limits, maxDrawdown; pause.
- Security: ReentrancyGuard, SafeERC20, AccessControl; snapshot lastPrice/lastTimestamp; TWAP optional.
- Views: convertToShares/Assets, limits remaining, last price, circuit breaker status.
